items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: A little big band left over, Mitch Miller, Frank Sinatra.

ctx.x: So if you could think back to let’s say 1950 and the pop music or the music that was likely to be heard on the radio went really wide variety of things. A little big band left over, Mitch Miller, Frank Sinatra.
Rhythm and blues. In the early 50s I was dancing to that music.
